For T=lambda vv^T, W=det(EE^T), and rank-three core A0=A-diag(0,0,D), |pdet_*(A0)|=|lambda|[|det H| v^T Gv +(W/|det H|)||Hv||^2].

For H=[[0,c],[c,0]], the core volume is at least |lambda|W; if the rank-three range leverage is <=1/2 coordinatewise, the full scalar form retaining D has continuous C0 density with ||p_Q||_infinity <=3e(|lambda|W)^(-1/3); otherwise at most five physical coordinates have leverage >1/2.
